summary: Limited pastes skip the conditional path: no ETag, no 304 for If-None-Match or If-Modified-Since, and Cache-Control: no-store from the storage cache policy. Each content read of a limited paste uses a view. Unlimited pastes keep the strong ETag, 304 answers, and public caching.

intent.objective: Repair the view-limit failure: a limited paste must never get a 304 or an ETag, so each read uses a view. Keep conditional reads for unlimited pastes.

assumptions.rationale: A content read of a limited paste uses a view. The read handler sends 304 only for unlimited pastes, whose reads have no side effects.
Limited pastes are no-store and get no ETag. Unlimited pastes stay public and keep conditional reads.

preservedInvariants: Unlimited pastes send a strong ETag and answer a matching If-None-Match with 304.
Each content read of a limited paste uses one view.
